description: Recipients to whom personal data has been disclosed are not notified of rectification, erasure, or restriction of processing as required by Article 19.
applicability: Applicable when personal data has been shared with recipients. Controllers must notify recipients of changes unless impossible or disproportionate.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through review of data sharing records and notification procedures. Verify tracking of recipients and communication mechanisms.

sources.title: GDPR - Regulation (EU) 2016/679
sources.section: Chapter III - Rights of the Data Subject
